source.task: Support Python's __replace__ protocol on Specifier and SpecifierSet. Callers can override the operator/version of a single specifier, the specifiers in a set, or prerelease handling. Omitted fields retain their original values, and explicitly resetting prereleases to None restores automatic behavior. A no-op replacement returns the same object. Preserve the original on changes and reject invalid replacements. Document and test the API. Explicitly replacing a set with its equivalent specifiers is also a no-op.
